as_told.title: David Grusch as NRO liaison to the UAP Task Force

plain: A whistleblower named David Grusch says he was brought onto the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects, after the task force director "funneled the request through the ops center". Grusch tells Michels this as his own experience, and Eric W. Davis, a scientist who has worked with the Pentagon, adds that Grusch was the task force's liaison from the NRO, the agency that runs US spy satellites, and "took direction from" a man named Jay Stratton. Davis places this in 2020 and 2021 rather than in 2019, and it matters because it would put Grusch inside the government's own UFO effort.
